name: Sakuba Sakura
source:
The eldest daughter of the Sakiba family. Kaede is a twin and older sister.

She has been well-behaved since childhood and has a kind and cheerful personality to everyone. A kind older sister who loves the protagonist who was taken in by the Sakiba family when he was a child, and takes care of him.

At the school, she belongs to the tea ceremony club. She is popular among both men and women, but no one confesses because she is considered to be Takamine's flower due to her perfect behavior and because she is a little brocon.

After realizing that she is a succubus, she obediently follows her desires and begins to indulge the protagonist with a nori.
